```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.crop = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)

africa <- read_csv("data/africa_gapminder.csv")
gains <- read_csv("output/life_expectancy_gains.csv")
setbacks <- read_csv("output/setbacks_1987_1997.csv")
top10 <- read_csv("output/top10_life_expectancy.csv")
bottom10 <- read_csv("output/bottom10_life_expectancy.csv")

kenya <- gains |> filter(country == "Kenya")
```

## Overview

This report uses the Gapminder dataset to look at **`r n_distinct(africa$country)` African countries** from 1952 to 2007. Across the continent, life expectancy rose from **`r round(mean(africa$lifeExp[africa$year == 1952]), 1)`** to **`r round(mean(africa$lifeExp[africa$year == 2007]), 1)`** years on average. Kenya gained **`r kenya$gain`** years, from `r round(kenya$y1952, 1)` to `r round(kenya$y2007, 1)`.

## Where life expectancy is highest and lowest (2007)

```{r}
top10 |> select(country, lifeExp, gdpPercap, pop) |> knitr::kable(digits = 1, caption = "Top 10")
bottom10 |> select(country, lifeExp, gdpPercap, pop) |> knitr::kable(digits = 1, caption = "Bottom 10")
```

## Kenya and its neighbours

```{r}
africa |>
  filter(country %in% c("Kenya", "Uganda", "Tanzania", "Rwanda", "Ethiopia")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = lifeExp, colour = country)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Life expectancy (years)", colour = "Country") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Income and life expectancy

```{r}
africa |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, y = lifeExp, size = pop)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, colour = "darkgreen") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(x = "GDP per person (log scale)", y = "Life expectancy (years)", size = "Population") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Biggest gains, 1952-2007

```{r}
gains |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country, gain), y = gain)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Years gained") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Setbacks, 1987-1997

Between 1987 and 1997, life expectancy **fell in `r nrow(setbacks)` countries**.

```{r}
setbacks |> knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

## Kenya against the African average

```{r}
avg_africa <- africa |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(lifeExp = mean(lifeExp)) |>
  mutate(country = "Africa average")

africa |>
  filter(country == "Kenya") |>
  select(year, lifeExp, country) |>
  bind_rows(avg_africa) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = lifeExp, colour = country)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Life expectancy (years)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

*Data: Gapminder, via the `gapminder` R package.*
